## Features
- **Forge Cores are on the Relics tab**: how many you hold, and how many cores the junk relics would
  return if salvaged (wiki: salvage value = rarity multiplier × level — Common 5×, Uncommon 7.5×, Rare 10×,
  Epic 12.5×, Fabled 15×, Mythical 17.5×, Legendary 22×, Transcendent 26×).
- Junk relics that are outside the eight best and not worn are tagged `salvage`, so upgrading them is
  visibly a waste.
